market_outlook.short_term: Markets rally post-Fed hike but volatility elevated. Oil decline supports equities but gas price spike risk looms. Crypto weak on Clarity Act failure. Gold firm. Asian EMs outperform on oil and upgrade catalysts. Expect 2-4% VIX spike in coming weeks on Trump-Fed tension and AI regulation headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: Fed hike signals inflation persistence, capping rate-cut cycle. Fiscal sustainability concerns (Gundlach) suggest next recession will be sharper. AI regulation within 12 months will bifurcate tech winners/losers. Vietnam and Korea offer EM alpha. Commodity and gold allocation favored over 6-12 months. Data center energy demand is structural tailwind.
